search.stockfish: SF19 UCI_LimitStrength true, depth8, Threads1 Hash16; dedicated engine per game, at most two concurrent CPU searches

primary_estimator: Common logistic performance rating R solving sum(1/(1+10**((opponent-R)/400))) = total score. Explicitly conditional on Stockfish UCI_Elo settings in this protocol.
uncertainty: Bootstrap entire opening families jointly across both levels, including both colours. Report score and rating intervals; infinite rating samples remain unbounded, never replaced with a fake finite Elo.
terminal_policy: Natural outcomes with legal automatic draw claims. A 512-additional-ply cap marks unresolved games; no silent draw/adjudication in the rating.
boundary: All-loss/all-win results produce a bound, not an invented finite rating. If a weaker anchor is needed, its rating must be measured rather than borrowed from old default values.
limitations: Not FIDE, Chess.com or Lichess rating. Official handicap calibration is 120s+1s/CCRL40/4, not this depth8 protocol.
13 opening families, one model seed; SF19 internal randomized handicap has no exposed seed.
